regulators.scope: Every repository change candidate before acceptance into the main branch.
regulators.owner: Maintainer under PROFILE.md P07 and P16.
regulators.observation: Run the command and retain its exit status and individual check output.
regulators.changeProcedure: Amend BASE-Q03 through BASE-C02, update this registry, and review the complete check contract.
regulators.challengeProcedure: Open a reasoned dispute under PROFILE.md P08 and identify the affected rule and evidence.
regulators.disableProcedure: Use only a recorded emergency suspension under PROFILE.md P14 or an adopted legislative amendment.

regulators.scope: Push and pull-request checks executed by GitHub Actions.
regulators.observation: Inspect the workflow run for the candidate commit and retain the immutable run URL and result.
regulators.changeProcedure: Change the workflow in a reviewed tooling change and preserve consistency with tools.json and BASE-Q03.
regulators.challengeProcedure: Report a mismatch between local and CI execution under PROFILE.md P08 with both logs.
regulators.disableProcedure: Suspend only under PROFILE.md P14 or remove through an adopted replacement gate.

regulators.scope: Canonical Russian Constitution source, its declared SHA-256, and provision count.
regulators.owner: Maintainer under PROFILE.md P07 and P16.
regulators.observation: Run npm run check:data and compare the reported count and SHA-256 with manifest/provenance.json.
regulators.changeProcedure: Complete the constitutional update procedure, then update provenance and every dependent declaration in one candidate.
regulators.challengeProcedure: Identify the source bytes, expected declaration, and observed mismatch under PROFILE.md P08.
regulators.disableProcedure: No ordinary disable path exists; emergency handling preserves the last verified canonical commit under PROFILE.md P14.

regulators.scope: Repository JSON Schemas, governed manifests, rule coverage, and technical-regulator references.
regulators.owner: Maintainer under PROFILE.md P07 and P16.
regulators.observation: Run npm test and npm run check:data; review schema diagnostics and source-resolution failures.
regulators.changeProcedure: Change a schema and its governed document together, update tests, and use the ordinary BASE-C02 pass.
regulators.challengeProcedure: Report the rejected document, schema path, normative basis, and disputed validation under PROFILE.md P08.
regulators.disableProcedure: Replace the gate only through an adopted legislative change; emergency suspension follows PROFILE.md P14.

regulators.scope: Licensing-policy source revision and the repository license map.
regulators.owner: Organisational publication role and maintainer under PROFILE.md P02 and P07.
regulators.observation: Run the licensing-policy test and inspect git submodule status and LICENSE.md.
regulators.changeProcedure: Adopt a new policy revision through PROFILE.md P02 and BASE-C02, then update the pin, license map, registry, and tests together.
regulators.challengeProcedure: Raise a licensing-order dispute under PROFILE.md P08 and preserve the current pin until resolution.
regulators.disableProcedure: No ordinary bypass exists; external legal obligations and PROFILE.md P14 govern emergency containment.

externalSettings.scope: Branch protection or repository rulesets governing the main branch.
externalSettings.observation: Inspect the repository rulesets and branch-protection settings with authorised read access or query the corresponding GitHub API.
externalSettings.claim: The repository manifest does not assert that branch protection is active until an authorised observation is recorded.
